title: Compact Role Cards & Access Boundary Summaries for RBAC v2 Console
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Design a compact, scannable role card and an accompanying Access Boundary Summary pane for RBAC v2 in the Console. The goal is to let admins quickly understand what a role grants, where it applies, and which members will be impacted by changes, while exposing audit context and SSO mapping metadata. This ticket focuses on the visual patterns, microcopy, and interaction states (view / edit / preview / bulk-assign) plus accessibility and responsive behavior.

Background: Current role surfaces are spread across multiple screens and require context switching to evaluate inherited permissions and downstream impact. For RBAC v2 we want a single interactive card that surfaces: role scope (org/team/project), permission highlights (allow/deny key actions), inheritance chains, recent audit events affecting the role, SSO group mappings, and a grant-preview mode that shows effective permissions for a selected user. The card must be usable in lists, role detail pages, and in assignment modals.

Goals:
- Reduce cognitive burden for admins when assessing roles before edits or rollouts.
- Make it easy to preview who would gain/lose access during a rollout.
- Surface audit links and SSO mapping without overloading the primary card view.
- Support bulk member assignment workflows (search/filter/invite via SSO groups).

Scope (this ticket):
- Visual spec for Compact Role Card (list and expanded states).
- Access Boundary Summary panel design (slide-over) with grant-preview widget.
- Member assignment modal wireframes for single and bulk flows with SSO group mapping toggle.
- Microcopy for audit affordances (links to related audit log entries) and permission conflict warnings.
- Interaction notes for keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, and mobile breakpoints.

Out of scope: deep backend audit schema, SAML provisioning protocol changes, and actual implementation of permission calculation engine (handled by ENG).

Related artifacts: Figma mockups, Confluence spec, prototype for usability testing listed under attachments.
acceptance_criteria: Compact Role Card mockups exist for list view and expanded detail view in Figma
Access Boundary Summary slide-over shows role scope, explicit allow/deny highlights, inheritance chain, and last 3 audit events with links
Grant-preview mode can accept a username or SSO group and renders effective allow/deny for top 10 actions
Member assignment modal supports single add, search+filter, and bulk invite via comma-separated emails and SSO group selection
UI includes clear microcopy for 'impact preview' and warning states when a change will widen access
Design passes accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, aria labels for interactive controls, color contrast for status chips
Design handoff includes tokens and spacing guidelines and a documented interaction spec for ENG to implement rollout checks
design_decisions: Use compact cards with a single-line summary and a chevron for expansion to avoid list noise
Show up to 3 permission highlights (top risky actions) with ability to expand to full permission list in the slide-over
Include an inline 'SSO mapping' badge that opens a small arithmetic tooltip with mapped group names and sync status
Grant-preview will not calculate time-based constraints (e.g., MFA requirement) in this phase; show a 'more details' link to policy docs
Audit events shown are links to the Console audit view filtered to the role; inline entries are abbreviated for quick scanning
tradeoffs_considered: Tight card layout improves scanability but hides some granular permissions—mitigated by the slide-over expansion
Inline audit snippets increase context but add network calls; we limit to the last 3 and lazy-load on expansion
Grant-preview approximates effective permissions for speed; precise edge-case checks remain server-side and are surfaced in an 'inspect' action
Bulk assignment via SSO groups is powerful but risks accidental broad grants; we require an intermediate review step with impact counts
ux_flow_steps: 1. Admin lands on Roles list: each role rendered as Compact Role Card with scope, 1-line summary, and risk chips
2. Click chevron or role name -> Access Boundary Summary slide-over opens; top shows scope and mapped resources
3. Admin clicks 'Preview impact' -> grant-preview widget accepts a user or pick-from-members, shows effective allow/deny for top actions
4. From slide-over admin clicks 'Edit role' -> in-place editor toggles; if changes widen access a warning banner appears with 'Show impacted members' CTA
5. 'Assign members' from card opens Member Assignment modal; admin can add single emails, paste list, or pick SSO groups; preview shows estimated number of affected members
6. Admin confirms assignment -> modal shows audit summary and required confirmation; assignment action creates audit event and optionally a notification
qa_notes: Verify accessible names for chevrons and preview buttons (role name + 'expand' / 'preview impact')
Test slide-over lazy-load of audit snippets and confirm performance under 1000 roles
Check grant-preview against ENG's canonical permission calculator for a sample of 10 users and record mismatches
Validate bulk invite flow handles mixed SSO and email inputs and surfaces clear error messaging for invalid items
Confirm 'widen access' warning appears only when an added permission increases the union of allowed actions compared to baseline
